message: No detected input validation: The code performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; it directly constructs DataFrames and passes data through without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice, and there are no checksum verifications, signed URLs, or authentication mechanisms present.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or noise-detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present; ratings are used directly without any integrity check.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples against poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Although the code references loading initial weights via --load_init_weights, there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in any of the provided code snippets.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any differential privacy mechanism is imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any stress-test attacks are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of the test set, and no evidence that multiple independent metrics or audit trails are used to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path builds DataFrames and passes them directly to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming user/item/context inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model output scores for NaN values, probability bounds, or any sanity thresholds before returning recommendations.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a collaborative-filtering recommender system, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
